::: home-more
## Research in brief

On one side, extremal and probabilistic questions about graphs and hypergraphs: colourings, Ramsey numbers, embeddings, sparse regularity. On the other, what learning algorithms (best-response dynamics, no-regret learners, reinforcement learning) actually do when they play games against each other. The [research page](Research/research.qmd) has papers, talks and open projects; the [teaching page](Teaching/Teaching.qmd) collects course material.

## Besides research

-   Leading a cross-field project for an EU proposal of new regulations regarding nutritional information on food packaging.
-   Contributing to a project for Carbon Credit Assessment, in collaboration with a Swiss startup.
-   Writing a cookbook with all my family's traditional recipes.
-   Training for the Barcelona marathon (March 2027).
:::

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var canvas = document.getElementById('colouring-game');
  if (!canvas) return;
  var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  var statusEl = document.getElementById('game-status');
  var reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  var nodes = [], edges = [], adj = [], timer = null, moves = 0, pulse = -1;

  function css(name) { return getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(name).trim() || '#888'; }
  function palette() { return [css('--dm-teal'), css('--dm-plum'), css('--dm-ochre')]; }

  function build() {
    nodes = []; edges = [];
    var n = 22, tries = 0;
    while (nodes.length < n && tries < 4000) {
      tries++;
      var p = { x: 0.06 + Math.random() * 0.88, y: 0.08 + Math.random() * 0.84 };
      if (nodes.every(function (q) { return Math.hypot(p.x - q.x, p.y - q.y) > 0.15; })) {
        p.hidden = Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);   // a proper 3-colouring exists by construction
        nodes.push(p);
      }
    }
    var seen = {};
    nodes.forEach(function (p, i) {
      var cand = nodes.map(function (q, j) { return { j: j, d: Math.hypot(p.x - q.x, p.y - q.y) }; })
        .filter(function (c) { return c.j !== i && nodes[c.j].hidden !== p.hidden && c.d < 0.32; })
        .sort(function (a, b) { return a.d - b.d; }).slice(0, 3);
      cand.forEach(function (c) {
        var key = Math.min(i, c.j) + '-' + Math.max(i, c.j);
        if (!seen[key]) { seen[key] = 1; edges.push([i, c.j]); }
      });
    });
    adj = nodes.map(function () { return []; });
    edges.forEach(function (e) { adj[e[0]].push(e[1]); adj[e[1]].push(e[0]); });
  }

  function shuffleColours() { nodes.forEach(function (p) { p.c = Math.floor(Math.random() * 3); }); moves = 0; }
  function counts(i) { var k = [0, 0, 0]; adj[i].forEach(function (j) { k[nodes[j].c]++; }); return k; }
  function bestResponse(i) {
    var k = counts(i), best = Math.min.apply(null, k);
    if (k[nodes[i].c] === best) return -1;            // already a best response
    var opts = [0, 1, 2].filter(function (c) { return k[c] === best; });
    return opts[Math.floor(Math.random() * opts.length)];
  }
  function conflicts() { return edges.filter(function (e) { return nodes[e[0]].c === nodes[e[1]].c; }).length; }

  function size() {
    var r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(), d = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    canvas.width = Math.round(r.width * d); canvas.height = Math.round(r.height * d);
    ctx.setTransform(d, 0, 0, d, 0, 0);
    draw();
  }

  function draw() {
    var r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(), w = r.width, h = r.height;
    if (!w) return;
    var cols = palette(), line = css('--dm-line'), bad = css('--dm-conflict'), bg = css('--dm-bg');
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    edges.forEach(function (e) {
      var a = nodes[e[0]], b = nodes[e[1]], clash = a.c === b.c;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(a.x * w, a.y * h); ctx.lineTo(b.x * w, b.y * h);
      ctx.strokeStyle = clash ? bad : line; ctx.lineWidth = clash ? 2.2 : 1.4; ctx.stroke();
    });
    var rad = Math.max(6, Math.min(11, w / 45));
    nodes.forEach(function (p, i) {
      if (i === pulse) {
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x * w, p.y * h, rad + 6, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.strokeStyle = cols[p.c]; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x * w, p.y * h, rad, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
      ctx.fillStyle = cols[p.c]; ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = bg; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke();
    });
    var c = conflicts();
    if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = c === 0
      ? 'Proper colouring after ' + moves + ' moves.'
      : (stuck() ? 'Stuck: an equilibrium with ' + c + ' conflict' + (c > 1 ? 's' : '') + '.' : c + ' conflict' + (c > 1 ? 's' : '') + '.');
  }

  function stuck() { for (var i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) if (bestResponse(i) >= 0) return false; return true; }

  function step() {
    var unhappy = [];
    nodes.forEach(function (p, i) { if (bestResponse(i) >= 0) unhappy.push(i); });
    if (!unhappy.length) { pulse = -1; draw(); clearInterval(timer); timer = setTimeout(restart, 3500); return; }
    var i = unhappy[Math.floor(Math.random() * unhappy.length)];
    nodes[i].c = bestResponse(i); moves++; pulse = i; draw();
  }

  function restart(newGraph) {
    clearInterval(timer); clearTimeout(timer);
    if (newGraph || !nodes.length) build();
    shuffleColours(); pulse = -1;
    if (reduce) { var guard = 0; while (!stuck() && guard++ < 500) { var i = nodes.findIndex(function (p, k) { return bestResponse(k) >= 0; }); nodes[i].c = bestResponse(i); moves++; } draw(); return; }
    draw();
    timer = setInterval(step, 650);
  }

  document.getElementById('game-restart').addEventListener('click', function () { restart(true); });
  canvas.addEventListener('click', function () { restart(true); });
  if (window.ResizeObserver) new ResizeObserver(size).observe(canvas); else window.addEventListener('resize', size);
  new MutationObserver(draw).observe(document.body, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
  restart(true); size();
})();
</script>
```
